Mahātharvaṇarahasya
or Atharvarahasya.
-Ādyādiśrīmahālakṣmīhṛdaya from. See under Atharvarahasya.
Addl. ms.: Mysore N. D. VII.

Mahātheraṭīkā
one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan dated 1442 A. D. Ref. Pāli Tracts in Inscriptions, in the J. Myth. Soc. XXII, p. 411.

Mahātheramāleyya
Bud. Pāli. Paris Pāli p. 35. See also Māleyyadevatheravaṇṇana, Paris Pāli p. 35.
